title: Review: crypto2dev-shim pre-merge
description: Pre-merge MY-OSS review of the feature/crypto2dev-shim branch (crypto2dev_port.c, headers, test file). Audience: myself before merging to main on a public GitHub repo.
notes: Confidence: revised upward to 85% — wolfssl-as4.2 CONFIRMED via hmac.c. The SETKEY+UNAVAILABLE silent-wrong-MAC bug is real. New bug also found (wolfssl-as4.10): HmacCtx leak every Final+Free cycle. Three P0 correctness bugs total, all in HMAC code. The TLS primary use case avoids HMAC data > 64KB so bugs .1 and .2 don't trigger, but bug .10 (the leak) hits every TLS record MAC. Remaining uncertainty: whether any edge case in the pool/fd management was missed without a multithreaded stress test.
